description.value: A well-maintained 27-acre RV park in suburban South Surrey with ornamental gardens, a pool, showers, and laundry; listed as a caravan site with no tent camping confirmed, but a practical base near the US border crossing and Tsawwassen ferry.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active 27-acre RV park in South Surrey. Park Features page explicitly lists Showers, Laundry, Swimming Pool, Billiards, Library, and RV Storage. The Near By page lists several grocery stores (Save-On-Foods, Safeway, Choices, Thrifty Foods). The cancellation policy implies reservations are accepted. However, there is no mention of tent sites, hiker/biker sites, or any cyclist-specific accommodation — the site is branded entirely as an RV park with 270-unit capacity per OSM. Contact info (phone, address, email) on the website matches OSM.
concerns: No mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodation — may be RV-only
